scope: Real macOS TX with LAN receiver; single-contact mouse output

rootCause.before: MacOsInputSink rejected contact DOWN with buttons=0 as invalid_state, stopping further input
rootCause.fix: Translate a buttonless contact lifecycle to primary mouse down/drag/up; preserve explicit mouse button validation

rustIntermittentFailure.error: Receiver HTTPS response failed: Invalid argument (os error 22)
rustIntermittentFailure.cause: Unconfirmed; TLS source unchanged and temporary tracing removed

realSessionAfterFix.operatorObservation: Operator confirmed both modes work after testing tap, scroll, release and returning to mouse selection

localInteractionModes.mouse: Mouse click, text selection and object drag
localInteractionModes.touch-scroll: Tap to click; single-contact movement produces anchored continuous pixel scrolling with begin/change/end/cancel phases

limitations: Close/reopen during a held gesture still requires separate device acceptance
No native multi-touch injection or inertial scrolling
Keyboard and standalone wheel records not implemented
